title: Refresh .slicer/.gitattributes in an existing project through the CLI
lead: `slicer setup-git` (or a flag on it) rewrites `.slicer/.gitattributes` from the current template, so an existing project picks up new merge-driver lines without running `init` or editing the file by hand.
findings_note: s257 relay, 2026-10-13: GITATTRIBUTES gained render/RELAY-ROLES.md, but only init writes .slicer/.gitattributes and init also rewrites config and templates
boundary: **Not in this slice:** rewriting config.json or templates, changing which lines the template holds, and repo-level .gitattributes outside .slicer/.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: s257 added `render/RELAY-ROLES.md merge=slicer-generated` to the template. `init` is the only command that writes `.slicer/.gitattributes`, and it also rewrites `config.json` and the templates. So this repo, and every existing project, has no CLI path to the new line. The owner's rule is that `.slicer/` files change only through the CLI.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body: src/slicer/ops.py (the GITATTRIBUTES write), src/slicer/cli.py (`setup-git`), tests/test_merge.py, docs/commands.md, docs/agents.md, CHANGELOG.md.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- `setup-git` on a project whose `.slicer/.gitattributes` lacks a template line rewrites the file to the template. It reports the path in its JSON payload and touches no other `.slicer/` file.
- A file that already matches the template is left byte-identical and reported as unchanged.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Factor the GITATTRIBUTES write out of `init` into an op that compares bytes and writes only when they differ.
2. Call that op from `setup-git` after its existing git config step.
3. Update the docs and the CHANGELOG.
4. Run it on this repo so `.slicer/.gitattributes` gains the RELAY-ROLES line.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- The full suite passes on Python 3.11+.
- `slicer setup-git` on this repo adds the line, and a second run changes nothing.
- `slicer check` and `git diff --check` pass.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: Worktree `.worktrees/s260`, branch `feature/s260-gitattributes`. Commit only on the branch. Merging and pushing wait for the owner.
